<!-- What changes for the person using the integration, and why. Link the issue if there is one. -->

- [ ] Tests for the behaviour this adds or fixes; `pytest`, `ruff check .`, `ruff format --check .` and, for the card, `node --test "tests/card/*.test.mjs"` pass
- [ ] No more requests per round and no shorter pauses between them, or the reason here
- [ ] Saved answers in `tests/fixtures` hold only what the test needs, no cookies
- [ ] New texts in `strings.json` and in every file of `translations/`
- [ ] `README.md` updated, if sensors, attributes, options or the number of requests change
